summary: Chande Kroll Stop: long and short stop lines built from ATR offsets of the recent 10-bar highs and lows.
overview: The Chande Kroll Stop draws two stop lines on the price chart: a long stop in green and a short stop in red.
It is a trend-following stop based on volatility.
how: First, preliminary high stop = highest high of 10 bars - 1 x ATR(10), and preliminary low stop = lowest low of 10 bars + 1 x ATR(10).
Then short stop = highest of the preliminary high stops over 9 bars, and long stop = lowest of the preliminary low stops over 9 bars.
use: Some traders watch price above both lines as a sign of an uptrend.
Use the lines as trailing stop levels.
Watch price crossing a line as a possible trend change.
Adjust the multiplier to make stops looser or tighter.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
Default settings are P = 10, X = 1 and Q = 9; the short stop sits above price and the long stop below in a steady trend.
